findings.current: This wasn’t just a broken nose. This was a broken nose and a cracked skull.
findings.defect: The translation generalizes the specifically injured back of the head into the entire skull, weakening the physical extension of the preceding proverb’s joke.
findings.rationale: 뒤통수 means the back of the head. The joke contrasts falling backward yet breaking one’s nose with Taekyung figuratively breaking both his nose and the back of his head.
findings.replacement: This wasn’t just a broken nose. The back of my head was cracked too.

findings.current: Im Kkeokjeong charged the Great Warrior chasing me.
findings.defect: The English presents the charge without the source’s explicit attempt framing.
findings.rationale: 차징(Charging)을 시도했다 explicitly says he attempted a charge, anticipating the attack’s immediate failure when he is hurled backward.
findings.replacement: Im Kkeokjeong attempted a charge at the Great Warrior chasing me.

findings.current: The last member had charged in with a dagger, taken a knuckle to the skull, and gone flying.
findings.defect: The phrasing makes the blow sound like an ordinary brutal strike and loses the comic diminishment of 꿀밤, a knuckle rap or bonk.
findings.rationale: The source humor contrasts the team member’s dagger charge with being dispatched by a childishly described 꿀밤 rather than a conventional punch.
findings.replacement: The last member had charged in with a dagger, taken a knuckle rap to the head, and gone flying.

findings.defect: “Bastard” overstates 인마 and collapses the deliberate profanity escalation before the later 개새끼야, which is correctly rendered as “son of a bitch.”
findings.rationale: 인마 is a rough attention-getting vocative here, while the substantially stronger insult is reserved for line 327.

findings.current: This can’t be. This seriously makes no sense.
findings.defect: The assembled copy removes the established italic formatting that identifies these sentences as direct thought.
findings.rationale: The Korean marks this as Taekyung’s internal thought, and both the project convention and accepted baseline distinguish direct thoughts with italics.
findings.replacement: *This can’t be. This seriously makes no sense.*

summary: Broadly faithful, with five minor defects involving a source-specific image, an attempted action, joke logic, profanity escalation, and thought formatting.
